name: Digital image catalogue and deduplication system

mentions.name: Digital image catalogue and deduplication system
mentions.description: A system that catalogues and indexes hundreds of thousands of digital images scattered across multiple devices so they can be deduplicated and collated effectively.
mentions.problem: Hundreds of thousands of images are scattered across multiple devices with no meaningful way to locate them, and buying more 18Tb HDDs is not an acceptable solution.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also trying to put together a workable system to catalogue and index hundreds of thousands of digital images scattered across multiple devices so I can deduplicate them and collate them effective.

evidence.value: I'm also trying to put together a workable system to catalogue and index hundreds of thousands of digital images scattered across multiple devices so I can deduplicate them and collate them effective.
